assets.prompt: Production sprite animation atlas for a cozy top-down pixel-art action RPG. This is ONE TRANSPARENT VFX ANIMATION SHEET, NOT skill icons or objects. EXACTLY 6 equal columns and 4 equal rows, strict regular grid, each of 24 cells entirely separate with 20% transparent gutters. Landscape 3:2 canvas. No labels or grid lines. Read each row LEFT TO RIGHT as six consecutive frames (small anticipation, fast onset, strong moving leading edge, follow-through, contracting tail, near-empty end). The center/anchor and pixel scale remain IDENTICAL through all six frames, never auto-crop individual frames. ROW 1: thin sharp ivory-silver crescent sword slash with subdued teal shadow, arc travels clockwise from upper-right through right to lower-right around an EMPTY center, narrow tapered blade-like leading edge and hollow interior. Do not draw a sword. ROW 2: compact punch/metal contact spark, ivory core and restrained warm brass shards, 3-5 purposeful short directional strokes, sharp crisp silhouette rapidly breaks apart. ROW 3: small physical fiery explosion: tight pale ignition core expands into 3 round lobes of amber and coral, dark plum separation, flame curls and limited angular fragments before breaking apart, strong distinct changing silhouettes. ROW 4: heavy blunt earth impact, flat ground dust compresses then launches 3-4 slate rock chips and low dusty mauve puffs, ground-plane ellipse rather than floating circular badge. All effects readable as moving impacts, not static emblems. Cute but professionally polished console pixel art. NATIVE logical cells 48x48 enlarged nearest-neighbor, chunky connected square pixel clusters, deliberate tapered contours, each material only 3-4 flat tones, muted plum outline used sparingly on dense smoke and rocks, highlights on leading edge only. Hard true alpha transparency outside strokes and puffs. NO icon, rune emblem, crest, weapon, character, UI frame, scene, floor, rectangular painted backgrounds, baked checkerboard, light rays, bloom, blur, gradients, glow fog, confetti or noise. Preserve large transparent negative spaces. Every action fully inside its cell; no cell bleed.

One transparent game SPRITE ATLAS, exactly TWO columns and TWO rows, four separate cells with large transparent gutters. Draw THE SAME cozy top-down RPG deployable stone-and-wood ward BARRICADE in four ground orientations. An actual solid placed object, not an effect, not an icon. Construction: THREE chunky blue-grey masonry panels joined by FOUR stout warm dark walnut posts with small brass fasteners; thick cool slate top caps, readable block seams, restrained pale blue inset diamond in each stone panel, no floating crest. Cute professionally authored chunky pixel clusters, dark plum contour, 3-4 flat tones per material. Orthographic overhead RPG view with visible FRONT-facing upright height; NO isometric camera. TOP LEFT: barrier laid along east-west ground line, wide horizontal construction. TOP RIGHT: identical barrier laid along north-south ground line, view from above so masonry top surfaces and depth remain visible; a continuous substantial blue-grey stone structure, never a thin stack of wooden sticks. BOTTOM LEFT: barrier ground line goes lower-left to upper-right; all posts still rise screen-up. BOTTOM RIGHT: barrier ground line goes upper-left to lower-right; all posts still rise screen-up. Each cell shows one COMPLETE grounded barricade with the same three masonry panels, four posts, same materials and consistent physical scale. Logical pixel art approx 64x64 per object enlarged nearest-neighbor. Each object centered in its cell with 20 percent clear margins. TRUE transparent alpha outside each silhouette; no floor, no ground shadow, no background, no labels, letters, borders, grid lines, characters, icon badge, sword, sparks, attack, glow, gradients, blur, haze or particles. The bottom contact line of each object must be clearly readable.
